verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official API reference for Radar resources, such as the reviews endpoints at docs.stripe.com/api/radar, and serves docs as markdown. However, nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or offers runnable examples, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. Missing for 10: evidence of interactive request execution, runnable code examples, a published machine-readable spec, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
